faqs.question: Who can become a PIC Partner?
faqs.answer: Anyone who is passionate about sustainability and wants to earn while making a positive environmental impact can become a PIC Partner. You just need to register and complete the verification process.

faqs.question: How do I earn as a PIC Partner?
faqs.answer: You earn commissions by referring customers to our eco-friendly products. Every successful purchase through your referral link earns you a percentage of the sale.

faqs.question: When and how do I get paid?
faqs.answer: Payouts are processed every month directly to your registered bank account. Minimum payout threshold is ₹500.

faqs.question: Is there any registration fee?
faqs.answer: No, registration is completely free! There are no hidden charges or fees to become a PIC Partner.

faqs.question: How do I track my referrals and earnings?
faqs.answer: You get access to a personal dashboard where you can track all your referrals, orders, commissions, and payout history in real-time.
